card.name: Time units and amounts in instructions
card.fires_on: The unit word after a number of time (minutes, seconds) in step-by-step directions. It also fires on small amount words like any, little, some before a comparison or duration.

modes.label: Duration units
modes.description: Minutes or seconds right after a number in how-long instructions.
modes.example: Clamp the urethral catheter or cystostomy tube for 10<< minutes>>. Remove the clamp and drain the bladder

modes.label: Degree words
modes.description: Small amount words such as any or little before a comparative like further or harder.
modes.example: Do not pull the sliders back<< any>> further as this could result in premature release

modes.label: Measurement unit
modes.description: The unit letter in a measurement like mmHg, after a number.
modes.example: the blood pressure is reduced 35 mmH<<g>> systolic and 25 mmH
